notes.title: Sitting Scene
notes.notes:
In Cam Op Simulator v1.18 we've added a new scenario that features an actor walking around a room and sitting and standing at a table.  The objective is to track the actor smoothly in a medium shot while anticipating the correct head room.  This was a commonly requested exercise by operators.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: VFX Super Hero
notes.notes:
This build of Cam Op Simulator has been updated to Unreal Engine 5.5.2.  If everything has gone well there should be no noticeable difference between the last version.  However, version 1.15 will be available as a beta branch in case this engine update causes issues.

The new map "VFX Super Hero" uses two new "Metahumans/virtual actors" that are more optimized than the previous virtual actors.  Hopefully this will allow for scenes with more actors while keeping the performance and frame rate high.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: Multi Cam Loop
notes.notes:
Cam Op Simulator 1.15 adds a new "Multi Cam Loop" map.

There are multiple cameras that can be operated.  You hit [ TAB ] to switch between cameras.  Switching between "Views" is now [ SPACE BAR ] in all Maps.

The cameras and talent/action will loop forever.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: Zoom Lens and Trinity Mode
notes.notes:
In this build we've introduced "Zoom Lenses" to the majority of the cameras.  To change focal length you can press [ Q ] or [ E ] on the keyboard.

The "camera monitor" has been redesigned to improve readability and to display the new "FCL" focal length field.

There is a new Trinity inspired mode where you can control the roll and tilt of the camera.

The FPV drone now has a control to tilt the FPV camera up and down.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: Geared Head, Laser Pointer, Pursuit Vehicle, FPV Pilot
notes.notes:
[b]Settings Manu[/b]
In this build we have introduced a new "Settings Menu" that is accessible when you press Escape/Pause in game.  In this menu you can adjust the "speed" and direction for mouse, gamepad, and Nodo wheels.

[b]Laser Pointer Mode[/b]
The first Laser Pointer map has you operating a virtual geared head with a laser that can "pop" targets.  The targets are on a sideways figure 8 track that you should stay on.  Pop all of the targets and you will get an accuracy rating at the end.

[b]Geared Head and Dolly[/b]
The geared head and dolly "Cinematic Shot" map has a simple dolly move where two actors interact with each other.  Practice tracking each actor and creating new shot variations.

[b]Pursuit Vehicle[/b]
A new WIP Pursuit Vehicle has been added in a new "Cinematic Shot" map.  The vehicles and UArm are completed controlled by the computer allowing you to focus on the camera operating.  There is a new "CamOp" view available.

[b]FPV Pilot[/b]
This new FPV Map is very experimental and requires a controller.  At this point we don't directly support proper FPV controllers like the Tango2, Radiomaster, DJI, etc. but we are working on this.  For now you can use an Xbox controller and possibly use a third party solution to remap an RC controller.  This mode requires 60-90+ fps to simulate correctly.

Thank you for supporting this very early version of the simulator and thank you for the feedback!

The best place to ask questions and get feedback is the Discord channel linked from the Steam page and the YouTube channel page.

Cheers,

Matt
